Overview.Name: Mahesh varma
Overview.Food_Habit: I lose control if I start eating
Overview.Goal: Looking better (appearance), Feeling energetic & confident, Preventing/reversing health issues, Mental wellbeing & stress reduction

Breakfast: Option 1: Rice rawa upma with vegetables (~1 cup cooked)
Option 2: Poha with vegetables (~1 cup cooked) and a side of curd (100 g)
Option 3: Plain curd (100 g) with cucumber and roasted makhana (30 g)
Lunch: Option 1: Cooked rice (~150 g cooked) with paneer curry (100 g) and mixed vegetables
Option 2: Cooked rice (~150 g cooked) with soya chunks (80 g) and a light vegetable curry
Option 3: Cooked rice (~150 g cooked) with curd (100 g) and a large salad
Evening_Snack: Option 3: Cucumber slices with plain curd dip (100 g)
Dinner: Option 1: Steamed vegetables with paneer cubes
Option 2: Vegetable curry with plain rice
Option 3: Light curd bowl with cucumber and rice

Notes_and_Tips: Keep meal timings regular and start meals with protein before rice.
Use simple home foods and keep a light snack ready for busy days.
Avoid fried foods, bakery sweets and sugary drinks where possible.
If cravings come up, wait 10 minutes and choose fruit, puffed rice or makhana first.
Stress or late-night triggers: take a short walk or rest before eating to avoid overeating.
